liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Candyman** (1 review): Listener praises John Mayer's handling of Candyman [19]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Listener singles out Iko Iko as a standout of the night [13]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Listener highlights the China Cat into Rider pairing [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Candyman**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 8 archived performances [21]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Here Comes Sunshine, Loose Lucy, Mississippi Half Step Uptown Toodeloo, Cumberland Blues, Casey Jones, Iko Iko, Standing On The Moon, Sugar Magnolia, U.S. Blues [21]

## The recordings

- **deadco2015-11-05.NickyC.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 17 songs; 177 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **deadco2015-11-05.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 180 min; rated 4.24/5 by 17 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording is good, but audible whistling from the audience bothers this listener; This recording has no dropouts, unlike the streams of the show that failed; Reviewer rates the sound the best of the shows heard so far, with a quick upload [12][14][16][18]
- **deadandcompany2015-11-05.skm140.sunboy.flac24**: source not stated; 17 songs; 181 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **DeadCo2015.11.05.audmtx**: source not stated; 0 songs; 181 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes this lineup had played live together only four times; most songs had rough patches [15]
- Reviewer felt Bobby seemed lost at times, while Mayer impressed [16]
- Lineup: Hart and Kreutzmann on drums, Weir, Mayer, Burbridge on bass, Chimenti on keyboards [4]
- Reviewer says Mayer's playing is the most powerful of this music since 1995 [11]
- Reviewer prefers Mayer's playing to the Warren Haynes era and to Trey at the Fare The Well shows [11]
- Reviewer calls this the most powerful post-Jerry version of the band [15]
- Setlist looks ordinary on paper, but as in the old days the playing mattered more [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2015-11-05.NickyC.flac16**: taped by Nicky C; transferred by Nicky C; source: MG21's>NBox>D100 [1]. Also: Taped on the floor at the rear of the GA pit, before the barricade, about 40 feet from stage; Gefell M21 microphones through Nbob active cables and Nbox Platinum into a Sony PCM-D100; Recorded in 1-bit DSD at 2.8 MHz [1][20]
- **deadco2015-11-05.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>Sound Devices MP2>Sony PCM-M10 [2]. Also: Recording credited to taper Keith Litzenberger; Schoeps MK41v mics, at the back of the GA pit about 40 feet from stage; Chain ran through KCY preamp, VST62iu, Sound Devices MP-2 and Sony PCM-M10, with only fades added [2][13]
- **deadandcompany2015-11-05.skm140.sunboy.flac24**: taped by Steven Weld; transferred by Steven Weld; source: Neumann SKM140(AK40's/LC3's/KM100's)>GAKables xlr>Lunatec V2>GAKables xlr>Apogee Mini-Me@24/48>AES/EBU>Sound Devices 722 @24bit/48kHz [4]. Also: Taped from the second row of taper section 7A, dead center behind the mixer enclosure, on a stand at 12 feet [4]
